title: Hosted API: Pinset templates, soft-fallback policies and attestable snapshot exports
creator: Aisha Ramesh
description: Create a composable workflow and UI/API primitives that let tenants declare reusable 'pinset templates' (preset region affinity + retention defaults), attach a soft-fallback policy, and produce a verifiable snapshot (attestable evidence bundle) of routing + retention choices for audits. This ticket scopes the product spec, acceptance criteria, and rollout approach for the hosted API flow and end-to-end evidence export. The goal is to give customers a low-friction UX for expressing residency constraints while enabling compliance teams to extract machine-readable proof bundles for audits.
acceptance_criteria: Admins can create, name, and version pinset templates in Console with fields: primary_regions (ordered list), fallback_policy (strict|preferred|soft-fail), default_retention_profile (30/90/365/custom), and enforcement_scope (endpoint-level|tenant-level)
Hosted API supports new header and config keys to bind requests to a pinset template and a runtime honor/observe mode that implements fallback semantics

Evidence export produces a signed snapshot (JSON + manifest) containing: applied_pinset_template_id, resolved_region_for_request, retention_profile, timestamps, deployment_id, and an integrity signature; export can be downloaded and programmatically retrieved via API

Soft-fallback behavior is enforced per policy: strict = reject non-matching regions, preferred = attempt preferred then fallback while logging deviation, soft-fail = always route but tag trace and surface alerts; behaviors must be demonstrable in test harness
Console shows per-endpoint last-applied-pinset, recent deviations, and a link to the attestation bundle for that time window
E2E tests cover: template CRUD, template binding in request path, policy fallbacks, evidence export integrity verification, and retention enforcement simulation
Security review completed and KMS signing configured for evidence snapshot integrity
implementation_notes: Work will span Console (UI), API surface, runtime routing, and attestable export plumbing. Proposed artifacts: PRD, API schema draft (OpenAPI fragment), Console mockups for template editor, runtime router feature flag, evidence manifest schema (JSON-Schema), and a lightweight attestation signer using existing KMS integration. Engineering will implement template storage as an immutable versioned resource (pinset-template:vN) to simplify auditability. Runtime needs to resolve templates at request time with a bounded cache and emit standardized telemetry tags for downstream evidence assembly.
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (Canary): backend API + immutable template store + simple Console template editor behind feature flag; enable soft-fallback and preferred modes in non-production regions. Phase 2 (Beta): add evidence export endpoint, signing, and retention profile UI; invite 10 pilot tenants. Phase 3 (GA): strict enforcement and tenant self-service, documentation, compliance playbook, and default templates for common regulatory regions. Monitor metrics: template adoption rate, fallback incidence rate, latency delta when templates applied, and number of evidence exports.
